Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R-Ga.) on Monday called out President Donald Trump after he questioned the results of this year’s midterms, despite his recent claims that he’d accept the outcome of the elections.

“For anyone who believes his bullshit, ask yourself, has he ever prosecuted ANYONE from the 2020 election??? NOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!” wrote Greene on X.

“With the same voting machines that he is complaining about today, as he attempts to build the same narrative. Any why not? Ask yourself honestly. Why hasn’t Trump, the President of the United States, with control of the DOJ, prosecuted anyone from the 2020 election?”

In a post to his Truth Social platform earlier in the day, Trump wondered aloud whether last week’s elections — which saw Republicans getting trounced in historic fashion — were “honest,” marking a revival of sorts of his “rigged” election talk that he spewed back in 2020.

“How could the Polls be so wrong???” he wrote. “Some early voting ‘dumps’ were so large that it was impossible to win, no matter how many people went to vote. It’s all about the machines, which are far more important than the voter!”

Greene — who has winked at plans that she’s planning an anti-Trump political party with former Fox News host Tucker Carlson — turned to what she called the “real truth” of the midterms: Trump supporters and Republicans stayed home in droves because they couldn’t support him and the party anymore.

“The polls weren’t really wrong, the polls his team showed him knew they were going to lose but lied to him that it would be this bad. Because his entire political team makes money off of rallies, fundraising, and everything to do with Trump involved in elections,” she wrote.

“And if they had told him it was going this bad, for one he might have changed course, but two probably would not have gone out and done rallies everyday like they had him doing.”

She concluded, “But really don’t feel too sorry for him. His ego and pride are hurt and he knows the big Democrat victory is 100% on him. So this is another attempt to deflect any wrong going off of himself.”
